_readme: The homepage. Edit this, drop images in public/home/, and the page
updates — no code change needed. Same pipeline as content/about.json.
EVERY PHOTO NEEDS A CREDIT. The `credit` field renders next to the image
and again in the colophon. A photo with no credit still renders, but the
build prints a warning, because shipping someone's photograph uncredited
is the one thing this project cannot do.
Sections left empty render as marked gaps rather than disappearing.
